'''LOUD''' is a Brazilian esports organization.

== History ==
Created in February 2019 by mobile games influencer [https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/PlayHard Bruno "PlayHard" Oliveira], '''LOUD''' started with a ''Free Fire'' team, and in 2020 the organization expanded into ''Fortnite''. In October 2020, Riot Brazil announced '''LOUD''' as one of the teams selected to participate in [[CBLOL/2021 Season/Split 1|CBLOL]] from the 2021 season onwards.

Sometimes called the "Brazilian FaZe Clan" due to their heavy focus on content creation, the team has gotten one of the largest fanbases in Brazilian esports. This has created what can be called the "LOUD Effect": when a player or personality joins the organization, the person's social media follower numbers skyrocket in a very short time.

As of May 2024, they were the first Brazilian organization to win four consecutive regional titles in a row.
